card.name: Words naming treatment vs placebo groups
card.fires_on: Words that name a study group or its risk in drug-versus-placebo comparisons, such as group, groups, patients, risk, or the after 'in'. It fires in adverse-event reporting of trial results.

modes.label: Group word after arm name
modes.description: The word group or groups right after a drug or placebo name in trial results.
modes.example: was 66% in the PLEGRIDY<< group>> and 11% in the placebo

modes.label: Risk or patients in comparisons
modes.description: The word risk or patients in relative or absolute risk comparisons with placebo.
modes.example: The absolute<< risk>> of probable dementia for CE plus MPA

modes.label: Linking word before arm name
modes.description: The word in or the just before a drug or placebo arm name.
modes.example: in 2% and 1% of patients in<< the>> NINLARO and placebo reg
